item.title: What Ocarina of Time final battle was better: Original or remake? (Spoilers)
item.author: invalid@example.com (Uzumaki Goku)
item.dc:creator: Uzumaki Goku
item.content:encoded: I'm playing both back to back to spot the difference. From the big start of fighting Ganondorf to the end credits. What was better? Both are similar, but differ in some ways. For example, the Remake has no timer to escape which does take away a bit of the tension but does add some cool new set pieces to make up for it such as the Hookshot segment. The final battles are also more elaborate but I prefer the original's lighting for Ganon. So… both have their merit still.
